gemm_price_scope: L0 inclusive callback wall time, not isolated device cycles; all values are milliseconds.
gemm_residence_limitation: Variant callbacks use close-after-call contexts, clear padded host weight packs, and allocate/upload BOs again. Retaining an original source weight view is not retaining the packed/device weights. These prices do not establish tiling quality under matched residence/lifetime.

decode_search.coverage: Whole 36-layer decoder contexts; arbitrary decoder-internal GEMM/attention tiling is not covered.

fusion.ffn: One XRT dispatch sequences separate up/gate/SwiGLU/down firmware configurations.

conclusion: Current catalogue cannot establish that small operators should remain on CPU, nor that tiling is ineffective; on-chip fusion and joint tiling/residence/lifetime require additional implementations and measurements.
